example.title: Three-storey stucco office block with stone pilasters (Creators Syndicate Building)
example.place: Hermosa Beach, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 2000s three-storey office building on a Hermosa Beach corner: beige stucco under a steep front gable, stacked-stone pilasters at the corners, a recessed dark entrance and a band of dark windows, lettered name on the facade, public parking sign beside it. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
